findings.motion: SB 1174 Senate Third Reading, Assembly floor (no vote recorded)
findings.note: No vote recorded on the Assembly floor for SB 1174, which bars local voter-identification requirements; the bill passed 57 to 16. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page, which lists him as not voting.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Assembly Third Reading (no vote recorded)
findings.note: No vote recorded on the Assembly floor for AB 1116 (online voter registration without a driver's license or state ID, using the last four digits of a Social Security number); the bill passed 60 to 18. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page, which lists him as not voting.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Concurrence in Senate Amendments, Assembly floor
findings.note: Voted no on the Assembly floor (59 to 19) on concurring in the Senate amendments to AB 1116 (online voter registration without a driver's license or state ID). The Governor vetoed the bill on 2026-09-27 per the same page. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy.
